item.title: Lessons That Healed Me Then - Writing
item.author: ahmed@offsechq.com (A.Alghali)
item.description:
you go through life for a long time believing no one has ever suffered the way you have.
and then, one day, you read something. or you hear something.
and you realize your suffering does not isolate you. it is your bridge.

item.title: Lessons That Healed Me Then Series
item.author: ahmed@offsechq.com (A.Alghali)
item.description: When I turned thirteen, something shifted in me. it was not dramatic on the outside, but internally everything felt rearranged. I was lost in a way I could not articulate. I could not understand my emotions, nor my behavior, nor the sudden cynicism that began to color the way I saw the world. I became negative, sharp, and difficult, and I started affecting the people around me without even noticing.
